page_title: LEV 4-0 UNI | Bayer Leverkusen v Union Berlin 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
87' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Victor Boniface.
87' That's the end of the game for Exequiel Palacios, who is replaced by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' Here is a change. Florian Wirtz is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Noah Mbamba (Bayer Leverkusen).
83' 4 - 0 Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
81' Here comes a substitution. Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Jeremie Frimpong.
81' Substitution. Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Jonas Hofmann.
78' Urs Fischer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) replacing David Datro Fofana.
78' A substitution has been made. Jerome Roussillon goes off and Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) comes on.
78' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
77' The ball possession is 66:34.
74' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
73' 3 - 0 Goal! Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
73' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
72' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

72' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayer Leverkusen.
71' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
70' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
69' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
68' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

67' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Frederik Ronnow.
65' A superb shot by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
64' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Sheraldo Becker.
61' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.

59' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Frederik Ronnow is alert and denies him with a nice save.

57' 2 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:0.
57' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the corner.
55' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

54' Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Lukas Hradecky pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
51' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
49' The Bayer Leverkusen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Jeremie Frimpong, but he puts too much power on the pass.
46' Urs Fischer has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Christopher Trimmel comes on the pitch for Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
46' Referee Timo Gerach blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Some great play by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
41' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
39' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Florian Wirtz.
38' It seemed like Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
38' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Diogo Leite (Union Berlin). Timo Gerach saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
35' The corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
35' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a precise pass into the box, but Victor Boniface loses the one-on-one with the defender.
33' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Victor Boniface, but he puts too much power on the pass.

30' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Frederik Ronnow shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
30' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
28' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
28' Referee Timo Gerach sees the trip by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
27' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
26' Frederik Ronnow pulls off a great save to deny Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
24' Leonardo Bonucci (Union Berlin) is substituted due to injury. Urs Fischer gives a chance to Robin Knoche.
23' 1 - 0 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
21' The foul by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) was seen by Timo Gerach who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
17' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.

16' There's a break in play and referee Timo Gerach must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayer Leverkusen using VAR. This could be interesting!

16' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
15' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) will deliver the corner kick.
12' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
11' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Frederik Ronnow scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
11' A cross into the box from Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) is cleared.
9' Excellent touch by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
8' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
7' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
5' A pass into the penalty area from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
2' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
